description: This file is a main package for a Go-based agent application that configures, registers, and runs a set of remote and local reasoners (function handlers) for processing messages and commands using the Agent-Field SDK. It initializes configurations from environment variables, registers reasoning functions like 'add_emoji', 'say_hello', and 'demo_echo', and sets up CLI and logging behavior for interactions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes configuration, registers reasoners ('add_emoji', 'say_hello', 'demo_echo'), and starts the agent service, handling conversation flow and CLI output.
